title: Why the Jeter-Pillars band left the Plantation
summary: After ten years the club replaced the band with big names like Cab Calloway and the Mills Brothers, which Pillars says began its downfall.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it

Well, here's what happened. The band had been there for ten years. This actually was the beginning of the downfall of the Club Plantation, when they got rid of our band, and started bringing in the big name and the big acts. They brought in Cab, they brought in the Mills Brothers. Now, the Mills Brothers -- they spent that kind of money for people like the Mills Brothers, and Cab Calloway. But I don't think they spent that kind of money for Louis Russell. Did Louis Russell play the Plantation?
